A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Bimm''' served as an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] aboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She was present aboard the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Inferno" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ensign first appeared in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'', the sixth novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, written by [[Troy Denning]] and released in [[2007]].<ref name="Inferno" />
